files.ops/auth-rollout.md:
# Reporting authentication rollout

Target database: inventory
Target role: report_reader
All clients for this role support SCRAM. Its password has already been reset and is stored using scram-sha-256. The loader role will migrate separately.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then update the local authentication rule: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/auth-password.html . Read ops/auth-rollout.md and config/pg_hba.conf under /app. Complete the final pg_hba.conf step of the documented MD5-to-SCRAM migration for the rollout target. Replace only the authentication-method token on that target host line with the documented SCRAM method; preserve every other character. Do not connect to PostgreSQL or change passwords.
